title: Eye Measurement
text: Calculate metrics from eye diagram, 3 inputs, {Eye mask type} sets Shape of eye mask; {Enable threshold input port}, {Modulation} sets the number of symbol levels in eye diagram, {Symbol thresholds}, {Enable clock input port}, {Clock type} determines how to sample waveform clock signal, {Clock threshold} sets the edge detection threshold for waveform, {Clock mode} sets the represent how data is captured by recovered clock, {Clock phase offset} sets the phase delay for moving clock PDF, {Window phase offset} sets the delay between ideal clock edge and timing, {Symbols per diagram} sets the width of eye diagram in symbols, {Amplitude range} sets the minimum and maximum eye amplitudes in eye diagram, {Amplitude bins} sets the number of amplitude bins in eye diagram, {Time bins} sets the number of time bins in eye diagram, {Hold off time} sets the delay before measurement analysis, {Symbol time} sets the time for one, {Sample time} sets the time for one sample, {Add Metric} adds new metric, {Remove Selected Metrics}, {Store results in base workspace} sets the store metric results to base workspace, {Metrics variable name} sets the name of metrics variable that stores measurement results, {Export to file} sets the export simulation results, {Export to base workspace} sets the export simulation results to base workspace, {W1 (UI)} sets the width of rectangle, diamond, and center of hexagon eye, {W2 (UI)} sets the width of top and bottom of hexagon eye, {H}, {Position mask in eye} sets the position of origin of shape of mask in eye diagram, {Custom eye mask} defines custom eye mask from eye mask, {Margin SER} sets the symbol error rate to measure eye mask margin, {Margin extrapolation} sets the extrapolation method to generate eye, {Mask variable name} sets the name of mask variable to export, {Export mask to file}, {Export mask to base workspace}, {Show plots at end of simulation} sets the automatically show plots at end, {Plot grouping} defines how plots are grouped together Subplot on same, {Add Plot} adds new plot, {Remove Selected Plots} and {Show Plots}. Values come from the instance.
